decisions.reason: The building digital twin service still shows only a website mention and no sign of traction, so its value remains uncertain, but digital twins are a growing field and holding the option for one more year costs little.
The open GIS framework is core to the firm's component and standards strategy and costs little to maintain, so its strategic option value clearly justifies keeping it.
The firm already dropped the overlapping authentication service C and kept this identity service, which suggests it is the consolidated option worth further commitment.
The consulting workshop was only just launched with its own page, builds on existing expertise at very low cost, and its prospects are still too uncertain to justify abandoning it.
